review.title: Rebase from an earlier operation while preserving working-copy files

pixel_review.summary: Reviewed all four full-size PNGs. Real historical operation ID and fixed repository wrap completely inside opaque options/preview; yellow warnings distinguish historical execution. Completion shows moved source, preserved after-baseline bookmark and historical completion message. Command History shows successful rebase stderr; its long header clips and operation metadata is absent, consistent with UX08/UX15.

text_style_review.summary: Read all four State JSON texts/styles. Teal controls and yellow warning spans use opaque dark backgrounds, colored graph identities remain distinguishable, and history transcript is neutral captured text. Four assertions prove unchanged on-disk files, later bookmark preservation and actual rebase operation parentage at the selected historical operation.

video_review.summary: Reviewed 25.93-second MP4 via decoded four-second samples plus final frame and tape timing. Visible human typing enters the real prepared operation ID; each completed drawer/preview/result has a three-second hold. Final C then two-row move selects the rebase transcript. Caption says the command is retained; its clipped header remains a documented UI limitation.
